file_insights.changes: Added linting commands section with targets for ruff, mypy, and bandit
key_additions: Added 5 new phony targets: lint, format, format-check, typecheck, security, quality
Added help documentation for code quality commands
Implemented composite 'quality' target that runs all checks sequentially

patterns_discovered.description: Using poetry run to execute linting tools (ruff, mypy, bandit) ensures dependency consistency
Quality meta-target aggregates multiple checking tools into single command for convenience
patterns_discovered.evidence: quality target chains lint, format-check, typecheck, security

patterns_discovered.description: Added new help section matches existing help format and style with echo statements
patterns_discovered.evidence: New 'Code Quality' section inserted between production and maintenance sections

patterns_discovered.description: Linting tools reference shared pyproject.toml for configuration

gotchas_discovered.description: The 'quality' target lists lint, format-check, typecheck, security as prerequisites but doesn't declare them with proper Makefile dependency syntax
gotchas_discovered.note: Works due to make's implicit handling but violates explicit Makefile best practices

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Path inconsistency in bandit vs ruff
gotchas_discovered.description: Ruff targets check 'apps/ config/' but bandit uses same with -r flag, creating potential coverage gaps if paths diverge
gotchas_discovered.impact: Both tools must be kept in sync manually if directories change

gotchas_discovered.description: The quality target runs format-check after lint without running format first, may cause quality check to fail if formatting is needed
gotchas_discovered.note: This is likely intentional as a read-only verification step, but could confuse users

approach_outcome.summary: Successfully added comprehensive linting infrastructure to Makefile
tasks_completed: Added 5 individual linting command targets (lint, format, format-check, typecheck, security)
Created composite quality target for running all checks
Updated .PHONY declaration with all new targets
Added user-facing help documentation for new commands
Integrated existing tools: ruff, mypy, bandit via poetry

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit Makefile dependencies to quality target
recommendations.rationale: Replace 'quality: lint format-check typecheck security' with proper target prerequisites to ensure correct execution order and dependency resolution
recommendations.example:
quality: lint format-check typecheck security
	@echo "All code quality checks completed"

recommendations.recommendation: Add separate 'format-all' target that runs formatter before check
recommendations.rationale: Provide users with easy way to auto-fix formatting issues without manually running format then checking
recommendations.impact: Improves developer experience by reducing manual steps

recommendations.rationale: Add comment in Makefile noting that 'apps/ config/' paths must remain synchronized across all linting tools
recommendations.impact: Prevents future bugs when directory structure changes

recommendations.recommendation: Add 'test-quality' target that validates linting tools are installed
recommendations.rationale: Verify all poetry dependencies (ruff, mypy, bandit) are available before running quality checks
recommendations.impact: Catches missing dependencies early with clear error messages
